## What's free

30,000 credits/month (about 6,000 small Docker minutes), 5 active users, 30 concurrent jobs, 2 GB storage

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://circleci.com/pricing/> before relying on this.

## Notes

Credits expire monthly. The default medium resource class uses credits twice as fast as small.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
